# @game-studio/cabinet

This readme contains an overview of the cabinet module with usage examples.

## Usage

```ts
import Cabinet from '@game-studio/cabinet'
import { Device } from '@game-studio/device';

export default class CustomCabinet extends Cabinet {
    constructor(device: Device) {
        super(device);

        // Your implementation
    }
}
```

## Development

### Linting

```
npm run lint
```

Runs `eslint` and outputs any errors.

### Building and Documentation

```
npm run build
```

This will clean the distribution folder, build the project and generate the documentation.

### Publishing

This package should not be published manually. Publishing is handled by the parent [game-studio](https://github.com/tombolaltd/game-studio) using lerna.

**Note:** it's worth noting that the private registry the package is published to is defined in the `package.json` file.

### TypeScript

#### tsconfig.json

This package is built in TypeScript and the options are controlled by `tsconfig.json` for use in the IDE.

### abstract methods
**onMenuButtonClick**
This method is called when the user clicks the Menu Button

**onIncreaseStakeClick**
This method is called when the user clicks the increase stake button and should return an object containing the formatted stake and the stake in raw pennies

**onDecreaseStakeClick**
This method is called when the user clicks the decrease stake button and should return an object containing the formatted stake and the stake in raw pennies

**getStake**
This method is provided by the user and should return an object containing the formatted stake and the stake in raw pennies


### optional extendable methods
**onActionButtonClick**
This method is called when the user simply clicks the Action Button (Pointer Down and Pointer Up), calling super on this will trigger the loading spinner

**onActionButtonHold**
This method is called when the user holds their click on the action button (Mouse down), calling super on this will do nothing as there is no base implementation necessary

**onActionButtonHoldEnd**
This method is called when the user stops holding their click on the action button (Mouse Up), calling super on this will do nothing as there is no base implementation necessary

**onActionButtonHoldEndOutside**
This method is called when the user stops holding their click on the action button (Mouse Up) outside of the actual button, calling super on this will do nothing as there is no base implementation necessary

**onGameInfoClick**
This method is called when the user clicks the Game Info Button, calling super on this will do nothing as there is no base implementation necessary

**setCabinetOverrides**
Does nothing by default. This method should be overwritten when the user wishes to ensure that overrides occur during orientation change


### public methods
**preload**
A static method that preloads the assets before initialising the cabinet, if the user wishes to

**init**
Initialises the cabinet, should be called once after the cabinet has been newed up

**enablePurchaseButton**
Enables the purchase button to be interactable

**enablePurchaseButtonInteractivity**
Enables the interactivity without changing anything else

**disablePurchaseButton**
Prevents the user from interacting with the purchase button

**disablePurchaseButtonInteractivity**
Disables the interactivity without changing anything else

**enableStakeButtons**
Enables both the plus and minus buttons

**disableStakeButtons**
Disables both the plus and minus buttons

**enablePlusButton**
Enables just the plus button

**disablePlusButton**
Disables just the plus button

**enableMinusButton**
Enables just the minus button

**disableMinusButton**
Disables just the minus button

**disableAll**
Disables all buttons bar the menu button

**updatePurchaseText**
Takes 1 argument, 'newText' which is a string and updates the text on the purchase button with the new text

**hidePurchaseText**
Hides the purchase text on the purchase button

**showPurchaseText**
Shows the purchase text on the purchase button

**setCabinetMessage**
Takes 2 arguments, 'message' which is a string and an optional 'amount' which is a string. Updates the message in the message box of the cabinet, if an amount is passed it will split the message into 2 lines

**setCurrentBalance**
Takes 1 argument, 'amount' which is a string and updates the displayed balance

**setAutoPlayText**
Takes 1 argument, 'textSet', and updates the text strings shown on the auto play popup using that object

**hide**
Hides the entire cabinet

**show**
Shows the entire cabinet

**updatePurchaseTexture**
Takes 1 argument, 'newTexture' which is a PIXI.Texture and updates the texture of the purchase button

**animateStakeText**
Takes 1 argument, 'text' which is a string and changes the stake text to the passed text argument and animates it as though the user changed stake, also accepts an optional fontsize parameter that updates the text size

**hideLoadingSpinner**
Hides the loading spinner around the action button

**showLoadingSpinner**
Shows the loading spinner around the action button

**showActionHoldSpinner**
Shows the action hold spinner around the action button

**hideActionHoldSpinner**
Hides the action hold spinner around the action button

**showAutoPlayPopup**
Shows the auto play popup

**hideAutoPlayPopup**
Hides the auto play popup

**enableGameInfoButton**
Enables the game info button, making it clickable

**disableGameInfoButton**
Disables the game info button, making it no longer clickable

**flashMessage**
Takes 1 argument, 'isWinner' which is a boolean and flashes the message box if the 'isWinner' argument is true

**bounceActionButton**
Triggers the bounce animation for the action button

**reset**
Resets the cabinet to its default state, 'not bought in' and enables both of the stake buttons

**handleOrientationChange**
Takes 1 argument, 'device' which is the extended device for the game. Should be called when the user changes orientation, updates the sizes of each of the elements of the cabinet to handle the new screen size

**destroy**
Destroys the cabinet and its children


### public setters
These setters need to be set before the cabinet is initialised or orientation has changed, otherwise it will not properly update the cabinet options

**menuButtonComponentVisibility**
Takes an object with a landscape and portrait property which are both booleans and determine whether the menu button should be shown in landscape or portrait

**balanceComponentHeader**
Takes a string and updates the header text of the balance text pane

**gameInfoComponentVisibility**
Takes an object with a landscape and portrait property which are both booleans and determine whether the game info component should be shown in landscape or portrait

**loadingSpinnerDuration**
Takes a number of seconds, this determines how long the animation the loading spinner should take. Default 2 seconds

**holdSpinnerDuration**
Takes a number of seconds, this determines how long the animation the hold spinner should take. Default 2 seconds

**gameInfoTexture**
Takes a PIXI Texture and sets the texture for the game info button, needs to be called before initialisation or orientation changed if implemented

**messageComponentFontScale**
Takes a number and sets the scale of the message components font

### public getters

**CabinetDimensions**
Gets an object containing the width and height dimensions, as well as the x and y coordinates of the cabinet

**gameInfoTouchStartTime**
Gets the absolute value of the time when the game info button was first pressed down

**autoPlayPopupVisible**
Gets the visibility of the auto play popup
